settings.label: Server addresses
settings.help: Example: http://192.168.1.10:4533. For the same server's LAN and public addresses, separate them with commas, preferred address first. Up to 5 addresses; HTTP and HTTPS are supported.

settings.label: Username
settings.help: Enter the username you use on your music server.

settings.label: Password
settings.help: Enter your server password or Subsonic app password. MyGo shows and saves it as plain text. Use a separate account with only the permissions you need.

settings.label: Sign-in method
settings.help: Leave blank for the recommended method (token). Enter legacy only if your server requires it. The plugin will not switch methods automatically.

settings.label: Music folder ID (optional)
settings.help: Leave blank to use all music folders. To limit supported library views to one folder, enter its server ID, not its name or disk path. Playlists are not filtered.

settings.label: Save listening history
settings.help: Enter true to send played tracks to your server. Leave blank or enter false to keep this off. Uses MyGo's played event; it does not check whether you finished the track.
